title: WHIP endpoint
description: The mixer runs the WHIP server. A browser needs nothing but this address to publish to it.

port.title: Port
port.description: The TCP port the endpoint's HTTP server listens on. 8889 is what mediamtx used, so an address already written down keeps working.

bind.title: Interface
bind.description: 0.0.0.0 listens on every interface. Give one address to listen on that one only.

path.title: Path
path.description: The part of the URL after the host, beginning with a slash. A publisher is given http://<this machine>:<port><path>.

stun_server.title: STUN server
stun_server.description: How the two ends learn their public addresses. stun://host:port. Leave empty on a local network, where it is not needed.
